correctness.rationale: By complete bipartite connectivity, for mixed-shore A every F yields connected A union F and the facets are all k-subsets U. If nonempty A lies only in L, connectivity is equivalent to F meeting R, hence admissible complementary k-facets have <=b-1 vertices of R; the capacity total M-1 ensures every smaller independent set extends to a k-facet. This is precisely rank-k truncation of partition matroid with R capacity b-1, and the other side case is symmetric. Matroid pure vertex-decomposability and shellability give integral sphere wedges. In the full (k-1)-skeleton S, augmented oriented chain boundary is contraction by the sum functional; its top kernel is wedge^k W_U. The relative C_*(S,X) is the truncation of the augmented simplex complex on L\A shifted by b and tensored with sign(R). It has top homology sign(R) tensor wedge^{k-b} W_{L\A} (zero if k<b); the pair long exact sequence yields the asserted integral H-module short exact sequence without an integral splitting assumption. Ranks yield beta=C(M-1,k)-C(|L\A|-1,k-b) for A subset L and analogous R; permutation exterior determinant yields the character. Independently enumerated connectivity and all k-facets vs matroid model in 11,680 cases for 2<=a,b<=5 and all admissible roots/r, all equal. Finite check does not prove infinite rank and module formulas.

originality.rationale: Deshpande–Roy–Sawant establishes vertex-decomposability for rooted co-connected complexes with CONNECTED induced root; complete bipartite roots entirely contained within a shore with >=2 vertices are disconnected, so the new uniform classification covers previously excluded roots. The explicit natural partition-matroid identification, integral top Betti numbers and non-split-equivariant exact sequence are not supplied by that theorem. Complete multipartite unrooted higher-independence is a different construction; matroid shellability itself is credited as standard.

final_claim: For all a,b>=2, nonempty proper root A in K_{a,b}, |U|=M>=2, 1<=r<M and k=M-r, the relative r-co-connected complex Sigma_r(A,K_{a,b}) is rank-k truncation of the uniform or a two-block partition matroid; it is vertex decomposable and a wedge of beta(k-1)-spheres with explicit beta, plus an integral S_{L\A} x S_{R\A} equivariant top-homology exact sequence.
